lens: Systems architecture — one object, one state machine.
object_model: The screen contains one chase owning the same 59 tile DOM nodes throughout its lifecycle. Loose, it is the complete atlas; composing a protocol selects and orders a subset inside that chase, so the Protocol Workbench is an interaction with the atlas rather than another surface. Advancing the quoins produces locked, and lifting resolves that state into lifted, pied, or bound.

mapping.how: A dependency camera over the loose or composed chase derives shadows from the current element or protocol selection; two stored protocol selections can project onto the same 59 tiles without creating duplicate objects.

Twelve simultaneous protocol columns and their plate would duplicate the chase. Its essential result already appears by loading each protocol into the same chase: structural deaths pie or bind, while the implementation-bug death lifts solid.
In-degree is immutable tile geometry carried through every named state; it changes neither object identity nor lifecycle.
The camera visits the selected tiles in causal order while their recorded depth determines position and lightness; law hairlines and rejected alternative stubs are derived overlays on the same chase.
Dragging and keyboard-moving tiles selects, deselects, and orders a protocol directly within the loose chase. Empty valence sockets expose required family alternatives, so no bench object exists.

On the loose chase, computed topological rank controls projected position while recorded S0–S4 remains encoded by lightness; disagreement is visible on the existing tiles without becoming another lifecycle state.

It represents whole legal protocol combinations and forbidden regions simultaneously, not one selection of 59 elements. Its nodes are protocols rather than tiles, so treating it as a chase state would hide a genuinely second object and a separate accessibility, rendering, and navigation cost.

Its 19-socket plate is an unrelated object, and its dissolving bottomless bars misuse an asynchrony property that belongs to exactly one element. The unknown survivor count supplies no valid chase transition.
In loose state, pushing a criterion through aligned tile notches selects the matching tiles from the same chase; the result feeds composition rather than creating a card-deck surface.

gestures.does: Projects its transitive law closure through the Photogram camera.

gestures.input: Drag a loose tile, or use keyboard move controls
gestures.does: Adds, removes, or reorders it in the composed protocol selection.

gestures.input: Push a criterion through aligned notches
gestures.does: Selects matching tiles in the loose chase.
Moves composed to locked in dependency order; the async-impossible tile requires one uninterrupted gesture.
Resolves it to lifted when closure is complete, pied when support is missing, or bound when reflexive structure closes on itself.
Tests rigidity in lifted state and becomes the destructive force in bound state.
Returns the chase to composed, after which clearing the selection returns it to loose.

strain: The Descent and Constraint Crystal are being forced into cameras even though each wants an orthogonal spatial arrangement of the tiles; keeping them derived projections avoids a second domain object but adds camera-layout state and substantial reduced-motion and keyboard-equivalence work. Substitution Space cannot be forced this way: it is the one justified second object, because its primitives are possible protocols rather than elements.

dissent_rulings.why: Binding is a real terminal state of the same over-constrained chase, while dimming invents no state and incorrectly demotes the unselected atlas vocabulary.

build_order: Ship composed to locked to lifted or pied for one sound and one incomplete protocol, using the real DOM tiles with equal keyboard and reduced-motion artifacts.
Make loose the complete 59-element atlas and implement protocol composition as selection and ordering within that chase.
Add hazard misalignment, no-bottom continuous locking, and the bound terminal state.
Add the Photogram and The Descent as derived cameras.
Add the Constraint Crystal camera and The Needle selection gesture.
Build Substitution Space last as an explicitly separate surface.
what_others_will_force: Falls Through: its twelve columns and plate are memorable theatre, but they duplicate the chase and restate outcomes the lock-up already demonstrates.
